title: Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship
program_type: Competitive university merit scholarship for international undergraduates, applied as a tuition-fee discount through a separate scholarship application
implementing_agency: Durham University International Office, Inspiring Excellence Scholarship Team (inspiring.excellence@durham.ac.uk)
programme_action: Inspiring Excellence Scholarships scheme, undergraduate strand: Inspiring Excellence 5k (UG) and Inspiring Excellence 10k (UG) award types
description: The Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship is a competitive partial scholarship for self-funded international applicants seeking admission to an eligible full-time, in-person undergraduate degree programme at Durham University for the 2027/28 academic year. It is offered in two award types: Inspiring Excellence 5k (UG), worth up to GBP 15,000 for three-year programmes (GBP 5,000 per year), and Inspiring Excellence 10k (UG), worth up to GBP 30,000 for three-year programmes (GBP 10,000 per year). The award is applied as a tuition fee discount against the original tuition fee, with no cash alternative, and is held for up to three years subject to continued strong academic progress. A separate scholarship application form is required in addition to the UCAS application, and the scheme runs three application rounds.

award_types: Inspiring Excellence 5k (UG) - GBP 5,000 per year, up to GBP 15,000 for three-year programmes
Inspiring Excellence 10k (UG) - GBP 10,000 per year, up to GBP 30,000 for three-year programmes
programme_structure.award_types_detail: Durham publishes two undergraduate award types under the Inspiring Excellence Scholarships scheme. Inspiring Excellence 5k (UG) is a GBP 5,000 per year tuition fee discount, up to GBP 15,000 for three-year programmes. Inspiring Excellence 10k (UG) is a GBP 10,000 per year tuition fee discount, up to GBP 30,000 for three-year programmes. Both are discounts against the original tuition fee for the programme, are applied at enrolment, and carry no cash alternative. Renewal differs by award type: the 5k award requires passing all modules with an overall mark of at least 60% each year, while the 10k award requires passing all modules with an overall mark of at least 70% each year, stepping down to the 5k value in the following year if the recipient passes all modules with at least 60% but falls short of 70%.
programme_structure.renewal_criteria: Awards are offered for up to three years, with the second and third year dependent on ongoing strong academic progress. Inspiring Excellence 5k: the recipient must pass all modules and achieve an overall mark of at least 60% each year. Inspiring Excellence 10k: the recipient must pass all modules and achieve an overall mark of at least 70% each year to continue receiving GBP 10,000; a recipient who passes all modules with at least 60% but falls short of 70% receives the GBP 5,000 award in the following year instead. Recipients of either award type who fail to pass all modules or fail to achieve an overall mark of 60% are not eligible for the scholarship in the following academic year. Where a recipient registers for a programme with a Placement or Study Abroad year, the award is applied to years one, two and four, is not applicable during the Placement or Study Abroad year, and continuation to year four depends on performance in year two.
programme_structure.automatic_consideration: Not automatic on admission. A separate Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship Application Form must be completed in addition to the UCAS application. Applicants do not need to hold an academic offer at the time of scholarship application, but must have submitted a UCAS application for an eligible programme before submitting the scholarship form. Unsuccessful applications are automatically carried forward to the next round and reconsidered alongside new applications, so a further form is not required.
programme_structure.intake: September 2027 entry only (2027/28 academic year). The scholarship applies to courses commencing in September 2027, is not transferable and is not deferrable; a recipient who defers enrolment has the award withdrawn.

application_deadline.typical_application_window: The scholarship application opens on 1 October 2026 and the scheme runs three rounds: round one closes 7 December 2026, round two closes 15 March 2027 and the final round closes 1 May 2027. All round deadlines are published as 23:59 GMT. Applicants applying after the UCAS equal consideration deadline of 13 January 2027 at 18:00 UK time are advised to apply in the second round.
application_deadline.application_period: 1 October 2026 to 7 December 2026 for round one; 15 March 2027 for round two; 1 May 2027 for the final round. A UCAS application for an eligible full-time in-person undergraduate programme must have been submitted before the scholarship form is completed, and the UCAS equal consideration deadline is 13 January 2027 at 18:00 UK time. An academic offer is not required at the point of scholarship application.
application_deadline.official_rule: The official Terms and Conditions dated 26 August 2026 publish a Key Dates table: Inspiring Excellence Scholarship Application Opens 1 October 2026; First Round Application Deadline 7 December 2026; First Round Results Announced 18 December 2026; UCAS Equal Consideration Deadline 13 January 2027; Second Round Application Deadline 15 March 2027; Second Round Results Announced 29 March 2027; Final Round Application Deadline 1 May 2027; Final Round Results Announced 15 May 2027. The scholarship web page gives the same three deadlines with the times 23:59 GMT. deadline_date carries the first-round deadline, the next deadline in the current cycle; there is no single central deadline because three round deadlines are published.
application_deadline.deadline_warning: The three deadlines are distinct round deadlines, not one closing date: 7 December 2026, 15 March 2027 and 1 May 2027, all at 23:59 GMT. The 7 December 2026 date in deadline_date is the first round only and is not the final opportunity to apply. Applicants who submit after the UCAS equal consideration deadline of 13 January 2027 at 18:00 UK time are advised by Durham to submit their scholarship application in the second round.

programme_duration.official_range: Up to three years, subject to maintaining strong academic progress
programme_duration.renewal_note: Renewed for up to three years subject to academic progress. The 5k award requires passing all modules with an overall mark of at least 60% each year; the 10k award requires passing all modules with an overall mark of at least 70% each year, and steps down to GBP 5,000 in the following year if the recipient passes all modules with at least 60% but below 70%. Failing all modules or falling below 60% ends eligibility for the following year. For programmes with a Placement or Study Abroad year the award covers years one, two and four only, is not paid during the Placement or Study Abroad year, and continuation to year four depends on year-two performance. Suspension of studies withdraws all future scholarship fee discount.

funding.monthly_amount_note: No monthly stipend or maintenance payment is published. The award is applied as a reduction to tuition fees at enrolment and there is no cash alternative.
funding.travel_amount_note: No travel, installation, visa or insurance payment is published. Applicants fund their own travel, visa and Immigration Health Surcharge costs, and their own living costs.
funding.fully_funded_note: Not fully funded. The award is a partial tuition fee discount of GBP 5,000 or GBP 10,000 per year for up to three years. It does not cover living costs, travel, visa costs, the Immigration Health Surcharge, or any part of the tuition fee above the discount, and no cash alternative is offered.
funding.number_of_awards: Limited (Durham states only 'Limited' for the number of awards available and publishes no exact figure)
funding.award_type_values: Inspiring Excellence 5k (UG): up to GBP 15,000 for three-year programmes (GBP 5,000 per year). Inspiring Excellence 10k (UG): up to GBP 30,000 for three-year programmes (GBP 10,000 per year).

tuition.conditions: Applied as a tuition fee discount directly against the undergraduate programme tuition fees and adjusted at the time of enrolment. No cash alternative is offered. Renewal is conditional on passing all modules and meeting the award's overall mark threshold each year. The award cannot be held in conjunction with any other scholarship, funding award or sponsorship from Durham University or any external organisation.

accommodation_support.note: No accommodation support is provided by this award. College residence charges and living costs are met by the recipient.

bond.note: No service bond, repayment obligation or return-to-home-country requirement is published. Recipients are, however, expected to participate in and support marketing and communications activities on behalf of their faculty and/or Durham University ('Scholarship Commitments'), which may include testimonials, public relations opportunities, attending open events and webinars, or acting as a student ambassador or student representative. Failure to fulfil Scholarship Commitments may result in future scholarship fee discount being withdrawn, and Durham reserves the right to recover pro rata any discount already received.

Applicants of any nationality, subject to Overseas fee status (no country restriction is published)
Applicants who have applied through UCAS to a full-time, in-person undergraduate programme at Durham University and hold a valid UCAS Personal ID
Applicants who select Durham University as their Firm choice by the UCAS reply deadline
Final-year secondary school applicants, including applicants with gap years and mature students, provided fee status and course conditions are met

final_year_condition: Applicants normally apply during their final year of secondary school or while holding a recent school-leaving qualification. An academic offer is not required at the point of scholarship application, but a UCAS application for an eligible programme must already have been submitted. To confirm the award, the recipient must meet all academic conditions stated on their UCAS offer, secure an unconditional place, confirm Durham as their Firm choice by the UCAS reply deadline, and enrol in September 2027.
equivalent_degree_note: Durham accepts a wide range of UK and international school-leaving qualifications for entry to its undergraduate courses, with country-specific requirements published on the international entry requirements pages and per-course entry requirements available through UCAS Course Search and the Durham course database. Applicants with a combination of qualifications can contact Durham for advice on how they are assessed together.

age_limit.official_source: No age limit is published for the Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship on the scholarship page or in the Terms and Conditions document.

eligibility.citizenship: No nationality restriction is published. Applicants of any nationality may apply, provided they are classified as Overseas students for tuition fee purposes. Nationality diversity is a stated factor in selection rather than an eligibility restriction.
eligibility.residence_requirement: Applicants must be classified as Overseas students for tuition fee purposes. Applicants with Home fee status are not eligible, and an applicant whose fee status is later changed to Home loses eligibility, with Durham reserving the right to withdraw the award and recover pro rata any discount already received.
eligibility.secondary_school_requirement: Applicants must have applied to a full-time, in-person undergraduate programme at Durham University and hold a valid UCAS Personal ID, and must meet or exceed the entry requirements for the programme applied for. BA (Hons) in Theology, Ministry and Mission and BA (Hons) in Theology and Religion are excluded from the scheme.
eligibility.academic_requirements: Applicants must meet or exceed the entry requirements for the programme applied for at Durham University. The scholarship sets no separate grade, percentage or GPA threshold; admission thresholds are set per course.
eligibility.gpa_requirement: No GPA, percentage or grade-point threshold is published for the scholarship itself. Entry requirements are per course and are stated in the applicant's UCAS offer; renewal requires an overall mark of at least 60% (5k) or 70% (10k) per year once enrolled.
eligibility.language_requirement: English language requirements belong to Durham's admissions framework, not to the scholarship, and are set by department. Almost all undergraduate subjects are assigned Band B, while the Law School undergraduate is Band A. Band B requires IELTS 6.5 with no component under 6.0, TOEFL iBT 80 with no component under 20 (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 with no component under 4 (tests from 21 January 2026), Pearson PTE Academic 62 with no less than 59 in each Communicative Skill, and Duolingo 120 overall with no sub-score below 110. Band A requires IELTS 7.0 with no component under 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90 with no component under 20 (or 5 with no component under 4.5), PTE Academic 68 with no less than 62 in each Communicative Skill, and Duolingo 130 overall with no sub-score below 120.
eligibility.extracurricular_requirement: Not a formal published requirement. Selection is based on the scholarship application responses, academic achievements and potential to make a positive impact after completing a degree at Durham, together with nationality diversity and balance across programmes.
eligibility.leadership_requirement: Not a formal published requirement; the same application-response and impact factors apply.
eligibility.financial_need: Not assessed and not means-tested. Applicants must be self-funded and not in receipt of any other scholarship, funding award or sponsorship from Durham or externally.
eligibility.previous_scholarship_restriction: The scholarship cannot be held in conjunction with any other scholarship, funding award or sponsorship from Durham University or any external organisation. Applicants and recipients must disclose any such funding, and Durham reserves the right to withdraw the offer and recover pro rata any discount already made where funding is not disclosed.
eligibility.enrolment_status_requirement: Applicants must have submitted a UCAS application for an eligible programme and hold a valid UCAS Personal ID before completing the scholarship form; an offer is not required at application. Recipients must secure an unconditional place, confirm Durham as Firm choice by the UCAS reply deadline and enrol in September 2027. Applicants admitted through Clearing, selecting Durham as Insurance choice, or progressing via the Durham University International Study Centre are ineligible.
eligibility.field_restrictions: Open to full-time, in-person undergraduate programmes at Durham University, excluding BA (Hons) in Theology, Ministry and Mission and BA (Hons) in Theology and Religion. No other subject restriction is published for the undergraduate award.

academic_requirements.percentage_note: No fixed percentage, grade or grade-point threshold is published for the scholarship. Applicants must meet or exceed the entry requirements of the programme applied for, which are set per course and stated in the applicant's UCAS offer. The only percentage thresholds that apply are the renewal conditions once enrolled: an overall mark of at least 60% each year for the 5k award and at least 70% each year for the 10k award.
academic_requirements.programme_specific_requirements: Entry requirements vary by course and are published per country on Durham's international entry requirements pages, on UCAS Course Search and in the Durham course database. Durham states it accepts a wide range of qualifications from the UK and the rest of the world, that some courses require previous study in certain subjects, and that applicants with a combination of qualifications can contact the University for advice.
selection_factors_may_include: Potential to make a positive impact after completing a degree at Durham
Nationality diversity and balance across programmes
academic_requirements.holistic_selection_note: Selection is holistic and based on the scholarship application responses together with academic achievements and potential impact, with nationality diversity and programme balance also considered. Durham publishes no weighting between these factors, no minimum grade threshold for selection, no interview and no portfolio requirement.

english_requirement.moi_rule: Durham states that applicants who have completed, or are currently completing, a degree in which at least one full academic year was studied in the UK or in another majority English-speaking country may be exempt from an additional English language test, provided this was within two years of the start date of the programme applied for. Durham also lists recognised English-speaking countries on its English language requirements pages, from which applicants do not need to prove English. This exemption framework is part of Durham's admissions requirements, not a scholarship rule.
english_requirement.test_score_note: The requirement is department-specific rather than scholarship-specific, so no single minimum score is universal and the universal fields above are null. Durham assigns an English language band by subject and study level, published on its 'English language levels required' page. For undergraduate study almost all subjects are Band B; the only undergraduate exception published is the Law School, which is Band A. Direct Entry Band B (undergraduate standard): UKVI/SELT IELTS 6.5 with no component under 6.0; non-UKVI/SELT IELTS 6.5 with no component under 6.0; TOEFL iBT and TOEFL iBT Home Edition 80 with no component under 20 for tests taken before 21 January 2026, or 4.5 with no component under 4 for tests taken from 21 January 2026; Pearson Academic PTE 62 with no less than 59 in each Communicative Skill (online PTE is not accepted); Duolingo English Test 120 overall with no sub-score below 110; Cambridge C2 Proficiency or C1 Advanced 176 with a minimum of 169 per component; Password Skills Plus 6.5 with no component under 6.0; Trinity ISE (revised) taken in the UK on the same day, ISE II 96 overall with a minimum of 90 in each skill; Cambridge O level English Language grade C or above; IGCSE First Language English grade C or above; IGCSE English as a Second Language grade B or above; GCSE English Language grade C / grade 4 or above. Direct Entry Band A (Law School undergraduate): IELTS 7.0 with no component under 6.5 (UKVI and non-UKVI); TOEFL iBT 90 with no component under 20, or 5 with no component under 4.5 from 21 January 2026; PTE Academic 68 with no less than 62 in each Communicative Skill; Duolingo 130 overall with no sub-score below 120; Cambridge C2 Proficiency or C1 Advanced 185 with a minimum of 176 per component; Password Skills Plus 7.0 with no component under 6.5; Trinity ISE III 105 overall with a minimum of 96 in each skill; the same school-qualification grade requirements as Band B. Pre-sessional English routes are also published for each band.

language_of_instruction.language_note: All eligible undergraduate programmes are taught in English. Modern language degrees involve the study of another language, but teaching and assessment at Durham are in English and the course's English language band still applies. No bilingual or non-English-taught undergraduate programme is eligible for this award.

application_method.application_route: Two-step route: apply to an eligible full-time, in-person undergraduate programme through UCAS before the equal consideration deadline of 13 January 2027 at 18:00 UK time, then complete the separate Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship Application Form online. A valid UCAS Personal ID is required on the scholarship form, but an academic offer is not required at the point of scholarship application.
application_steps: Apply for an eligible full-time, in-person undergraduate programme at Durham University through UCAS before the equal consideration deadline of 13 January 2027 at 18:00 UK time.
Obtain a valid UCAS Personal ID. An academic offer is not required to apply for the scholarship.
Open the Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship Application Form (published on the official scholarship page, opening 1 October 2026) and complete it, entering the UCAS Personal ID.
Submit the scholarship form by the relevant round deadline: 7 December 2026 (round one), 15 March 2027 (round two) or 1 May 2027 (final round), each at 23:59 GMT.

Await the round outcome by email: 18 December 2026, 29 March 2027 or 15 May 2027. Only successful applicants are contacted; unsuccessful applications are automatically carried forward to the next round and reconsidered alongside new applications, with no need to resubmit.
If selected, respond to the conditional scholarship offer and complete the Scholarship Response Form by the deadline stated in the offer email.
Confirm Durham University as Firm choice in UCAS by the reply deadline, meet all academic conditions of the UCAS offer, secure an unconditional place and enrol in September 2027.
The tuition fee discount is applied to the tuition fees at enrolment. Renewal in years two and three depends on meeting the award's overall mark threshold.

selection_criteria.academic_excellence: A stated selection factor. Applicants must meet or exceed the entry requirements of the programme applied for, and academic achievements are explicitly part of selection.
selection_criteria.leadership: Not a separately named criterion. Selection considers the applicant's potential to make a positive impact after completing a degree at Durham, which may encompass leadership.

selection_criteria.extracurricular_achievement: Not a separately named criterion; considered only within the application responses.
selection_criteria.financial_need: Not a selection criterion. The award is not means-tested, and applicants must be self-funded.
selection_criteria.additional_factors: Nationality diversity and balance across programmes are explicitly considered in selection.

degree_outcome.awarded_qualification: The undergraduate degree of the course studied (for example BA, BSc, BEng, LLB or integrated master's degrees where the programme is a four-year undergraduate award). The scholarship confers no separate qualification.
degree_outcome.typical_programme_length: 3 years full-time for most Durham undergraduate programmes; longer where the programme includes a Placement or Study Abroad year or is an integrated master's degree
possible_awards: Inspiring Excellence 5k (UG): GBP 5,000 per year tuition fee discount, up to GBP 15,000 over three years
Inspiring Excellence 10k (UG): GBP 10,000 per year tuition fee discount, up to GBP 30,000 over three years
degree_outcome.degree_note: The award is a tuition fee discount only and does not affect the qualification awarded. For programmes with a Placement or Study Abroad year the award is applied to years one, two and four and is not applicable during the Placement or Study Abroad year.
degree_outcome.credit_transfer: Not applicable. The award applies only to study at Durham University and is not applied during Placement or Study Abroad years or suspension of study.

student_rights_and_cost_protection.tuition_fee_for_recipients: The award is applied as a tuition fee discount directly to the undergraduate programme tuition fees, adjusted at the time of enrolment. No cash alternative is offered. International tuition fees are published per course and, for students starting in 2025/26 and later, are subject to annual inflationary increases of up to the higher of 6% or the latest annual CPI increase.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.application_fee_for_recipients: No fee is charged for the scholarship application form. The UCAS application fee is separate and is not covered by the award.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.student_agreement: Recipients must respond to the conditional scholarship offer and complete the Scholarship Response Form by the stated deadline, and must confirm Durham as their Firm choice in UCAS by the reply deadline. Terms and conditions are published both as a web page section on the scholarship page and as a downloadable Terms and Conditions document dated 26 August 2026.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.common_services: Recipients are expected to participate in and support marketing and communications activities on behalf of their faculty and/or Durham University ('Scholarship Commitments'), which may include testimonials, public relations opportunities, attending open events and webinars, acting as a student ambassador or serving as a student representative. Recipients must obtain prior approval from the International Office before making changes to their programme of study, including course transfers, programme changes or interruptions to study.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.bond_requirement: No bond, service obligation or repayment condition is published, and no return-to-home-country requirement applies.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.bond_breach_consequence: Not applicable as a bond. The scholarship fee discount is withdrawn, and Durham reserves the right to recover pro rata any discount already received, where a recipient suspends studies, fails to meet the grade requirements, is no longer classified as an Overseas student, receives other scholarships or sponsorship, or fails to fulfil the Scholarship Commitments. Deferring enrolment withdraws the award entirely.

practical_application_data.motivation_letter_strategy: Durham does not publish the individual questions on the scholarship application form, so the record does not assert their content. Selection explicitly weighs the scholarship application responses, academic achievements and the applicant's potential to make a positive impact after completing a degree at Durham, so responses should be specific and evidence-based rather than generic: concrete academic achievement, a clear account of the intended degree and why Durham, and a credible description of the impact the applicant intends to have afterwards. Because nationality diversity and balance across programmes are considered, the applicant's background and chosen subject should be presented honestly rather than adapted to a perceived preference.

risk_flags.risk: The scheme runs three rounds with different closing dates (7 December 2026, 15 March 2027 and 1 May 2027, all at 23:59 GMT).
risk_flags.impact: An applicant who treats the first-round date as the only deadline may miss later rounds, and one who waits for a later round reduces the time available to secure an unconditional place before enrolment.
risk_flags.mitigation: Submit in the first round where possible, since unsuccessful applications are automatically carried forward to later rounds without resubmission.

risk_flags.risk: Renewal is conditional on passing all modules and meeting an overall mark threshold each year (60% for the 5k award, 70% for the 10k award).
risk_flags.impact: The discount can lapse or step down in later years of the degree, and failing all modules or falling below 60% ends eligibility for the following year.
risk_flags.mitigation: Confirm the progression expectations of the chosen programme and plan study so the relevant mark threshold is comfortably met each year.

risk_flags.risk: Eligibility depends on being classified as an Overseas student for tuition fee purposes.
risk_flags.impact: An applicant later assessed as a Home fee payer becomes ineligible, and Durham reserves the right to withdraw the award and recover pro rata any discount already received.
risk_flags.mitigation: Check Durham's fee status guidance before applying and verify the fee status stated on any offer as soon as it is issued.

risk_flags.risk: The award cannot be held in conjunction with any other scholarship, funding award or sponsorship from Durham University or any external organisation.
risk_flags.impact: An applicant holding another award must choose between them, and non-disclosure can lead to withdrawal and pro-rata recovery of the discount.
risk_flags.mitigation: Declare all funding before applying and compare values before accepting either award.

risk_flags.risk: The award covers tuition fees only, with no living allowance, travel, visa or insurance support, and international fees are subject to annual inflationary increases of up to the higher of 6% or CPI.
risk_flags.impact: The student must independently fund living costs, travel, visa costs and the Immigration Health Surcharge, and the rising fee base can erode the relative value of a fixed discount in later years.
risk_flags.mitigation: Build a full costed budget covering fees net of the discount plus living costs, travel, visa and health surcharge before accepting.

risk_flags.risk: The award is tied to September 2027 entry, is not transferable and is not deferrable.
risk_flags.impact: A recipient who defers enrolment, changes programme without approval, or suspends studies has the award withdrawn, with pro-rata recovery possible.
risk_flags.mitigation: Obtain prior approval from the International Office before any course transfer, programme change or interruption, and confirm entry intentions before accepting.

risk_flags.risk: Recipients must fulfil 'Scholarship Commitments', including participation in marketing and communications activity.
risk_flags.impact: Failure to fulfil these commitments may result in future scholarship fee discount being withdrawn and pro-rata recovery of discounts already received.
risk_flags.mitigation: Review the Scholarship Commitments in the Terms and Conditions before accepting, and notify the Inspiring Excellence Scholarship Team promptly if temporarily unable to take part.

risk_flags.risk: Durham publishes the number of awards only as 'Limited' and does not disclose how the GBP 5,000 and GBP 10,000 values are allocated between successful applicants.
risk_flags.impact: Applicants cannot estimate their chances or predict which award value they would receive.
risk_flags.mitigation: Treat the award as highly competitive, do not rely on a specific value in financial planning, and confirm the offer value only when the conditional offer is received.

database_notes: Naming: the assigned target referred to a 'Global Excellence Scholarship' undergraduate round at Durham. No award by that name exists on durham.ac.uk; the 'Global Excellence' name at undergraduate level belongs to Trinity College Dublin, which is already on the do-not-duplicate list. Durham University's international undergraduate scholarship is officially named the Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship, offered as Inspiring Excellence 5k (UG) and Inspiring Excellence 10k (UG), and this record documents that scheme.

No substitution was required. The assigned target institution (Durham University) and its Inspiring Excellence scheme are not on the do-not-duplicate list in research/bachelor/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md, so this is the original target rather than a substitute.

Scope: this record covers the undergraduate strand of the Inspiring Excellence Scholarships scheme only. The scheme also includes postgraduate taught awards (Inspiring Excellence 5k and 10k for one-year taught MSc, MA, LLM or MDS programmes commencing September 2027, excluding MBA, MSW and MA in Theology and Ministry), which are out of scope for a bachelor's record.

Cycle: the record documents the 2027/28 cycle. Applications open 1 October 2026 and the three round deadlines are 7 December 2026, 15 March 2027 and 1 May 2027, each at 23:59 GMT. deadline_date carries the first-round deadline of 2026-12-07, the next deadline in the current cycle, with all three dates recorded in application_deadline.

Dates: last_verified_date, _verification_timestamp, logo_verified_at and image_verified_at use 2026-10-03, the verification date mandated by research/bachelor/SCHEMA_CONTRACT.md, and the ISO timestamps use 11:20 UTC as the time of reading.

Deadline precision: all three round deadlines are published as exact calendar dates with exact times (23:59 GMT) in both the scholarship web page and the Terms and Conditions document, so deadline_precision is 'exact'. single_central_deadline is false because three round deadlines are published rather than one.

English language requirements are Durham's admissions requirements, set by department band (Band A or Band B), not scholarship-specific rules. Because the band is department-specific, minimum_ielts, minimum_toefl, minimum_pte and minimum_duolingo are null and the full Band A and Band B tables are recorded in english_requirement.test_score_note rather than being universalised. All undergraduate subjects listed on Durham's levels page are Band B except the Law School, which is Band A.

English test validity: tests must have been passed no more than two years before the start of the course. GCSE, iGCSE and Cambridge O level English Language have a four-year limit, except iGCSE First Language English, which has no time limit.

TOEFL scoring: Durham publishes two score scales because of the TOEFL test changes of 21 January 2026. Tests taken before that date are scored on the 0-120 scale (80 for Band B, 90 for Band A); tests taken from 21 January 2026 are scored on the 1-6 scale (4.5 with no component under 4 for Band B, 5 with no component under 4.5 for Band A). Both scales are recorded.

The official scholarship page states in its undergraduate section that selection considers potential to make a positive impact 'after completing a postgraduate degree at Durham University', while the parent Inspiring Excellence Scholarships page says 'after completing an undergraduate degree at Durham University'. The undergraduate reading is used in this record and the inconsistency is flagged in verification.unverified_or_removed_claims.

Terms and conditions: the full Terms and Conditions are published as a downloadable PDF dated 26 August 2026, verified as reachable (HTTP 200, application/pdf, 173,434 bytes) and read in full for this record. The same terms also appear as a 'Terms and Conditions' section on the scholarship web page.
Number of awards: Durham publishes only 'Limited'. No award count is recorded anywhere in this record.

Application form hosting: the Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship Application Form is linked from the official scholarship page and hosted on forms.cloud.microsoft. The link was confirmed reachable (HTTP 200) but the form platform is not on the durham.ac.uk domain.

Fee context: Durham states that for students starting in 2025/26 and later, international tuition fees are subject to annual inflationary increases of up to the higher of 6% or the latest annual CPI increase. This is recorded as context for the lifetime value of a fixed discount and is not part of the award.

No bond or service obligation attaches to the award. Recipients do, however, undertake 'Scholarship Commitments' to support marketing and communications activity, and failure to fulfil them can withdraw future fee discount; this is recorded in funding_breakdown.bond and student_rights_and_cost_protection.

Logo: the official Durham University logo is verified on the provider's own domain (durham.ac.uk, /media/durham-university/site-assets/image/logo-dark.svg, HTTP 200, image/svg+xml, 16,662 bytes). No third-party logo source was used. No award-specific photograph asset was verified, so image_url is null.
